description: Labelled cases for the intent planner shadow evaluation (build order step A). Complements intelligence_questions.json with IFRS/IAS research, invalid inputs, mixed calculation-and-fact requests, follow-ups, insufficient evidence and security cases. expect_intent is the primary intent; expect_sub_intents lists every part of a mixed request; expect_tools is the minimum tool set; forbid_tools are tools the request does not need.
